name: Negative-funding capitulation long — deep negative carry into a price washout (funding + return, 1d)
rationale: MECHANISM: same negative-funding short-crowd squeeze thesis, but read on a daily clock and confirmed by a deep multi-day price washout (ret_Nd deeply negative) rather than an RSI/basis pair. Deeply negative funding_rate = crowded shorts paying longs; a large negative trailing return says the market has already capitulated hard, so the contrarian SPOT long (direction +1) buys the exhaustion and collects the negative-funding carry (funding_feature) while waiting for the squeeze. The daily horizon and multi-day hold target the slower recovery leg. DISCONFIRMER 1: kill if negative-funding daily events are too rare to clear effective-N. DISCONFIRMER 2: kill if the washout-buy is indistinguishable from a plain deep-drawdown dip-buy without the funding condition — the edge must be the short-crowd positioning, not generic mean reversion. DISCONFIRMER 3: kill if it catches knives during multi-week structural bear capitulation where negative funding persists and price keeps bleeding.
catalyst: deeply negative funding into a multi-day price washout — crowded shorts a daily spot long squeezes.
